shared_elements: schematic human/anthropomorphic figures with raised or outstretched arms
figures with weapon- or object-like attachments
justification: Both surfaces show schematic anthropomorphic figures with raised arms alongside animals and a circular motif, plus bands of repeated small marks, but these are generic to almost any figural tradition. A differs in showing boats with crew-strokes, stick-thin linear humans with weapons and a large ring in a scattered, non-registered scatter, while B presents heavy relief animals (quadruped, birds, a bird-headed creature) stacked in ordered horizontal registers on a single upright with a row of animal heads at the top.
